description: A short check for all staff at Carrholme Services, a fictional company, taken after the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten new items from a Carrholme inbox and phone, the same kinds as before. It is matched to the first check (awareness_pre_data_conduct_ba), and the end screen compares the two results when the first check was finished. Organiser note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
